windows.title: Observed post-maintenance CLOB recovery degradation
windows.latest_update_message: Official maintenance completed at 07:30 UTC, but eight silence-watchdog reconnects continued from 07:35:19 through 07:45:47. The window ends after five consecutive minutes without another reconnect. Received checkpoint books remained complete; archive cadence prevents using row counts alone as a depth-recovery boundary.
